mapper.insert: insert into user_security_audit (user_id, event_type, detail_json, ip_address, user_agent, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{eventType}, #{detailJson}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_security_audit where user_id = #{userId} and event_type = 'LOGIN_FAILURE' and create_time >= #{since} and id > coalesce((select max(success.id) from user_security_audit success where success.user_id = #{userId} and success.event_type = 'LOGIN_SUCCESS'), 0)
select * from user_security_audit where user_id = #{userId} and event_type = #{eventType} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1
